note: The specification subset of web-platform-tests that corresponds to what the Web PORT relies on of the platform, run in a reference browser as a check on the reference implementation, not as a gate on it (Bet 2, Bet 9): a failure here is the browser's defect against its specification, recorded in expected.json with what it means for the PORT, never a case this repository excuses. Files are fetched at the pinned commit by fetch.mjs and never copied into the tree.

tests.html/semantics/interactive-elements/the-: showModal(): the dialog is shown modally, with its steps and errors (the PORT shows an open layer with it)
close(): hides the dialog and fires close (the PORT hides a closed layer with it)
the close event: fired once, after the dialog is hidden (the PORT tells a close it did from one the browser did)
the cancel event: fired for a close request, cancelable (the PORT reports dismiss and refuses it)
cancel's preventDefault keeps the dialog open (a controlled dialog the application keeps open)
close requests without user activation between them: the second is not cancelable (the PORT draws the dialog again)
a modal dialog makes the rest of the document inert (the first rule of the pattern)
the dialog focusing steps skip what is inert
the open attribute: a dialog written open is not modal (the server-rendered upgrade)
what the dialog focusing steps focus
tests.html/semantics/popovers/popover-close-re: a close request closes the topmost popover
tests.dom/nodes/moveBefore/focus-preserve.html: moveBefore keeps focus and selection (what the PORT's own focus recipe does where it is absent or wrong)
tests.dom/nodes/moveBefore/modal-dialog.html: moveBefore of an element in a modal dialog
tests.dom/nodes/moveBefore/fire-focusin-focuso: moveBefore fires no focus events (the PORT does not report the ones of its own moves)
tests.html/semantics/interactive-elements/the-: sequential focus inside a dialog (Tab among its children)

not-run: popover-attribute-basic.html (mostly popover=hint and attribute-change reentrancy, which the PORT does not use), popover-focus.html (autofocus and invoker activation semantics the PORT leaves to the browser) and popover-events.html (its completion depends on timing this harness does not give it) were tried and left out; the PORT's own use of toggle is in integration/browser/layer.browser.test.ts. The tests that need testdriver's Actions are not in the subset.
